package.name: new_arm_driver
package.description: Lightweight host driver for the real ESPMax arm (direct servo path). Bridges between ROS (MoveIt FollowJointTrajectory / manual joint commands) and the ESP32 pass-through firmware: converts joint radians to Lobot pulses via a per-joint calibration, streams trajectory waypoints to /arm/servo_command, and turns /arm/servo_feedback back into /joint_states (computing the passive 4th joint). The host owns the kinematics; the ESP32 only moves servos.
